Model: session model (general-purpose review agent). No escalation. Gate route: pr-test.yml run 43645794944 (macOS runner), quick gate and clippy green.

The lane lost the completion note of the review agent; the cost is an estimate from comparable reviews.

Blended upper estimate at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower.

Rework pushed.
- The six source files have LF line endings again. The diff against main is now 63 added and 12 removed lines in 7 files.
- The branch has a clean merge of main. No conflict needed a hand edit.
- Tests: the one_wcs, setup_settings_page and structural tests pass (22 tests). Clippy on camcraft-ui and camcraft-app is clean.
- The before and after screenshots are still owed. No agent can start the GUI. The PR stays a draft until they are in the description.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 82fd8d7688cb506f78a454e0fd65a3d74f746eb2 -->

Needs changes before merge.

## What looks good

- The line-ending fix is confirmed. All six changed source files store LF. The diff against main is 7 files, +63/-12. No file shows a whole-file rewrite.
- The branch holds a clean merge of current main (`0db66c44e`). The diff against main shows only this PR's own 7 files. Nothing from main was dropped.
- The move is as issue #1648 asked. The Setup page no longer draws the work offset picker (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_settings_page.rs:87-90`). The WCS page draws it in its own group "Work offset (G54-G59)" (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:148-151`). The Setup page group takes the title "Set WCS from features", which now matches its one row.
- The control keeps its undoable command. `setup_wcs_pick.rs` is unchanged in this PR. It queues `CommandKind::SetSetupWorkOffset` through `state.pending` (line 89). Nothing writes the world from the panel. The layering holds: the diff adds no `sys_*` or world-level call.
- The structural tests pin the move on both pages, and no snapshot PNG changed. The new test `one_wcs::the_work_offset_control_is_on_the_wcs_page_and_not_the_setup_page` counts the combo (role `ComboBox`, value "Work offset 1 (G54)"): 0 on the Setup page, 1 on the WCS page. A second assertion pins the group under the origin group. `structural.rs` now reads 0 work-offset combos on the Settings page.
- `docs/decisions/1648-wcs-page-work-offset.md` follows the format in `docs/decisions/README.md`: decided, why, considered and dropped, cost.
- The PR body is complete: what changed, the pinning tests, what was not exercised, a `Changelog:` line, and `Fixes #1648`.

## Results

Built on the self-hosted runner (macOS): https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43652049800

- Trial merge with main `0db66c44e`: clean.
- Quick gate: pass. The ui suites ran 60 s, 0 failed. This includes the changed `one_wcs`, `setup_settings_page` and `structural` tests.
- Clippy on `camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not built locally: the diff adds no Windows-only readings, so the runner's arms cover it.
- This run replaces the green run `43645794944` on the old head `bacbfc3ef`. That run did not count for this head.

## Requested before merge

The code passes review. This PR owes one thing: a before/after screenshot pair in the body.

1. Add the before and after screenshots to the PR body. This PR changes a UI page, so rule #1209 needs the pair in the description. The body states "no screenshot exists" under Not exercised. Show the Setup page and the WCS page before the change, and both pages after it. This fix is a body edit. No push to the branch is needed for it.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The earlier note stands. The picker still draws its row label `"    Work offset"` with a leading indent (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_wcs_pick.rs:73`). Inside its own titled group the label repeats the title. A later issue can drop it.
- `pages.rs` is now 1,232 lines. Main has 1,230. Files already over the 400-line mark are a note, not a blocker.
- Commit `150e6201c` uses the type `style`. AGENTS.md lists `feat`, `fix`, `perf`, `refactor`, `test`, `docs`, `build`, `ci` and `chore`. `chore` would fit better. The PR subject is correct, so this does not block.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Estimated agent cost:** ~$0.48 (86k tokens, estimate)

Model: session model (general-purpose review agent). Route: pr-test.yml run + diff read (re-review of the rework head).

Blended upper estimate at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower.

Fix pass on review of head 82fd8d768.

The review has one blocking item: before and after screenshots in the PR body.

- This item needs the real app to render both pages. The rules for this session forbid launching the app. The agent did not make the screenshots.
- No code change is needed. The review found no code defect. The agent pushed nothing, ran no gate, and did not change the draft state or the labels.
- A person with a GUI session must add the screenshot pair (Setup page and WCS page, before and after) to the PR body.
